name: Tour Operator Operations
audience: small day-tour, activity, and multi-day tour operators
topic: departure manifests and guide coverage for tour operators

products.name: Departure Manifest Readiness
products.product: A focused tour departure manifest readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small day-tour, activity, and multi-day tour operators
products.problem: Bookings, waivers, pickup points, equipment, participant notes, and guide instructions change across channels until departure, creating competing manifest versions.
products.valueProposition: Turns tour departure manifest readiness into a visible operating queue so every departure has one frozen operational manifest with resolved blocking fields and controlled late changes.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tour manifest software, tour departure checklist, activity operator manifest, and tour participant roster searches.

products.name: Guide Cover Board
products.product: A focused tour guide scheduling and substitution workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small day-tour, activity, and multi-day tour operators
products.problem: Guide callouts are solved through group messages without consistently checking qualification, language, availability, transport, pay, and manifest acceptance.
products.valueProposition: Turns tour guide scheduling and substitution into a visible operating queue so every uncovered departure is accepted by a qualified guide or escalated to a documented operating decision before the guest notice cutoff.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tour guide scheduling, tour guide substitute, tour operator staff scheduling, and guide coverage app searches.
